result: For the 9x9 PPT crosshatch tensor Q tensor Q defined below, 65 explicitly identified five-coordinate Alice cuts are PPT states of Schmidt number exactly3 on 5x9, and 65 explicitly identified five-coordinate Bob cuts are PPT states of Schmidt number exactly3 on 9x5. The 130 are counted as oriented cuts, not claimed pairwise inequivalent or novel. The remaining 61 cuts on each side are NOT classified by this result. These are higher-dimensional source results, not solutions to the 4x4 SN>=3 witness target.
source: Q=[|10>+|02>]+[|20>+|12>]+[|00>+|21>]+[|01>+|22>] from https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 1; its partial transpose is an explicitly verified sum of four two-term projectors. Regroup Q tensor Q across A1A2:B1B2. Its sixteen tensor-ket generators have pairwise disjoint supports; coordinate projection keeps those supports disjoint. Each is a partial-permutation matrix, so its Schmidt rank after a cut is its number of surviving nonzero entries. Every generator in each of the 130 certified cuts has rank<=3, and the stored anchor has rank3, giving an immediate SN<=3 decomposition.
lower_bound_certificate: For each certified cut, fix the coefficient of its rank3 anchor to1 and write the complete range matrix using an independent complex variable for each other nonzero disjoint-support generator. The stored proof tree selects 3x3 minors. At every internal node, after setting the previously branched variables to0, a selected minor is exactly one nonzero monomial; rank<=2 forces at least one distinct factor to vanish, and the child list covers every factor. At every leaf a selected minor is a nonzero constant, contradicting rank<=2. This proves no SR<=2 range vector has a nonzero anchor coefficient. Since the positive state has that anchor in its actual range, the generalized range criterion gives SN>=3. Source PPT and local projection give PPT. Together with the displayed SR<=3 source-ket sum, each cut has SN exactly3.
example: Alice coordinates (1,3,4,5,7) give the trace28 5x9 PPT/SN3 source in frontier-20261028-crosshatch-56-source-and-range-v1.json SHA256 1c7acd7604339535bed120eedba098605431c227b6d865893e9c2fcbdec2cf65; that artifact also gives an elementary shorter proof using a 5x6 Bob cut. The remaining certificates supply the full 130-cut oriented census, not a claim that the configurations are new to the literature.

artifacts.observed: The independent integer replay reconstructs every recorded cut and source coefficient matrix, checks the Q partial transpose on all81 entries, verifies disjoint supports and partial-permutation rank<=3 for every generator, and checks every branch factor and nonzero constant in all11046 proof-tree nodes, including1696 closed leaves and maximum tree depth15. It verifies 65 unique Alice and65 unique Bob cuts, with output rank histogram {12:2,14:8,15:8,16:112}. It imports no search code, uses no floating arithmetic, and applies no upper claim to the unlisted cuts.

limits: The certificates establish only these 130 oriented 5x9/9x5 cuts. They do not give 4x4 SN>=3, a valid negative 2-block-positive witness, pairwise inequivalence, novelty, or an independent human/cross-vendor or formal proof.
